Title: Technical Program Manager, Network
Description:
**About Cape**
Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.
  
  
Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected
*and*
have privacy.
  
  
We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.
  
  
Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.
  
  
**The Team**
At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.
  
  
**The Role:**
Cape's network team designs how traffic actually moves through our infrastructure: routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and the vendor-implemented changes that make it all work. Right now, that work is coordinated ad hoc, and the team needs someone to take real ownership of task tracking, timeline accountability, and communication across engineering, business development, and vendors. This role is the first of its kind in the network team. We're looking for a Program Manager who is technical enough to challenge engineering estimates, sanity-check what BD is promising customers, and set delivery timelines the team can actually hit.
  
  
You'll work in close partnership with the network operations lead to roadmap upcoming work, surface dependencies and conflicts before they become fire drills, and keep vendors accountable to what they've committed to. Telco or network experience is a plus, but we care more about startup instincts and a bias toward realistic, forward-moving plans than about a background in telecom specifically.
  
  
**What You'll Work On:**

* Own Jira hygiene and task tracking for the network team, bringing structure to work that is currently coordinated informally
* Build a reliable system for tracking work, exposing dependencies, and catching timeline slips early, across network engineering, BD, and vendors
* Partner closely with the network team's technical lead to roadmap infrastructure work like routing, regional connectivity, subscriber provisioning, and cloud/vendor integrations
* Pressure-test proposed timelines and BD requests for technical feasibility before commitments are made externally
* Host vendor meetings and hold vendors accountable to their delivery commitments
* Deconflict priorities and dependencies across the network team and adjacent teams, including consumer-facing projects
* Translate technical network work for non-technical stakeholders, and translate business requests back into realistic technical asks for engineering
* Help define the org model for how program management, technical ownership, and execution responsibilities fit together on the network team as it scales

**Experience:**

* Technical program management experience in a fast-moving engineering environment, ideally at a startup
* A track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, cross-team work without slowing it down
* Comfort learning a new technical domain quickly and deeply enough to challenge engineering judgment and assess feasibility, not just track progress
* Experience building systems for tracking work, surfacing dependencies, and holding owners accountable to deadlines
* Strong communication skills; able to translate between technical teams and business/vendor stakeholders
* Comfort engaging directly with external vendors and holding them to their commitments
* (Bonus) Experience with network or telco infrastructure: traffic routing, cloud connectivity, configuration, or subscriber provisioning
* (Bonus) Experience at a company building or operating physical/network infrastructure rather than pure software
* (Bonus) Prior experience supporting consumer products alongside more technical/infrastructure work

**Compensation:**
We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role based in New York, NY is $190,00 - $210,000 depending on level, experience, and interview performance.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* 401(k) match
* 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents
* 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)
* Stipends for
* Family-forming needs
* Gender-affirming care
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Culture & Values**

* We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.
* We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.
* We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.
* We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.

Description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Atos is seeking a
**Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations**
to lead the North American client delivery organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive will be accountable for the operational performance, service delivery execution, customer experience, and financial health of a large, multi-practice delivery organization supporting more than
**$1 billion in annual business**
and a workforce of more than
**1,000 delivery professionals**
.
  
  
This leader will oversee a broad and complex portfolio that includes managed infrastructure services, compute, data center, network, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, digital workplace, application management services, staff augmentation, project-based delivery, and long-term managed services. The role requires a leader who understands the operational and commercial differences between time-and-materials engagements, project delivery, and managed services, and who can establish a consistent delivery model across them.
  
  
The Senior Director will serve as the delivery organization’s primary service provider to Atos account and client leadership teams. While this individual will not directly own customer accounts, they will be accountable for ensuring that the services promised to customers are delivered effectively, consistently, and profitably. The role will work closely with account teams, practice leaders, and business-line executives to align delivery capabilities with customer requirements and business commitments.
  
  
This leader will establish common operating practices, strengthen collaboration across business lines, clarify ownership, and modernize delivery through automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative operating models.
  
  
Success will require significant experience leading large-scale technology delivery organizations, strong commercial and financial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across a complex matrixed environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading through organizational change and operational uncertainty, stabilizing customers in crisis, challenging legacy approaches, and making difficult decisions while maintaining the trust of customers, employees, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Client Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own overall service delivery execution across the North American client delivery organization.
* Provide leadership across an organization of more than 1,000 delivery professionals supporting a business portfolio exceeding $1 billion annually.
* Ensure consistent achievement of contractual commitments, service-level agreements, operational targets, customer outcomes, quality standards, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear accountability for delivery performance across practices, business lines, and service portfolios.
* Create a culture of operational excellence, customer focus, transparency, urgency, and disciplined execution.
* Partner with practice leaders and account teams to identify and mitigate delivery risks before they affect customers.
* Serve as the senior executive escalation point for significant delivery, service, operational, and customer issues.
* Lead the stabilization and recovery of complex or distressed customer engagements, including situations involving service disruption, performance deterioration, delivery breakdowns, or customer dissatisfaction.
* Ensure delivery leaders maintain effective operational governance across both long-term customers and new or transitioning engagements.

Shared Delivery and Service Integration
  
  

* Lead an integrated delivery model encompassing staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services.
* Align delivery across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Ensure customers experience one coordinated Atos delivery organization, regardless of the technologies, business lines, or delivery teams involved.
* Establish standardized operating procedures governing service transitions, work transfers, escalations, ownership boundaries, resource deployment, and cross-practice collaboration.
* Eliminate operational silos and reduce delays, ownership confusion, inconsistent practices, and failed handoffs between service areas.
* Define clear roles and decision rights among practice operations, account leadership, client management, solution teams, and delivery organizations.
* Resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and operational conflicts that impede customer delivery.
* Preserve the technical expertise of individual practices while aligning them around common customer and business outcomes.

Financial and Business Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and operational performance of the North American client delivery organization.
* Drive improvements in margin, productivity, utilization, scalability, delivery quality, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with practice leaders, account leaders, finance, workforce management, and portfolio owners to optimize staffing, capacity, location strategy, and workforce planning.
* Maintain an effective balance between customer commitments, service quality, employee capacity, and profitability.
* Identify structural cost, productivity, and delivery-model improvements that strengthen the performance of the existing book of business.
* Support revenue retention and growth by increasing customer confidence, improving service consistency, and strengthening delivery credibility.
* Establish performance metrics, operating reviews, executive dashboards, and corrective-action mechanisms that provide transparency across the organization.
* Hold leaders accountable for operational commitments, financial performance, risk mitigation, and sustainable improvement.

Customer Experience and Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure delivery decisions are driven by customer impact rather than internal organizational boundaries.
* Improve customer satisfaction, service quality, responsiveness, reliability, and delivery consistency.
* Partner with account and client leadership teams to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide delivery expertise and operational support to account teams without displacing their commercial ownership of the customer relationship.
* Improve the organization’s ability to anticipate customer concerns and resolve issues before they become executive escalations.
* Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders during critical delivery situations, service recoveries, and major transformations.
* Reinforce accountability for the entire customer outcome rather than individual service towers, practices, or contractual components.
* Use customer feedback, operational data, service trends, and root-cause analysis to drive measurable improvements.

Transformation, Automation, and AI
  
  

* Develop and execute a transformation roadmap for the North American delivery organization.
* Modernize legacy processes, governance structures, and delivery practices to improve speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Advance the use of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent operations across service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate issue resolution, improve service predictability, and enhance the customer experience.
* Establish scalable operating models that support multiple service types, technologies, and customer environments.
* Promote greater use of standardized tools, processes, controls, and performance data.
* Lead the organization through a period of significant change while maintaining service continuity and customer confidence.
* Position the delivery organization to operate successfully in an increasingly AI-enabled technology services market.

Organizational and Practice Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction to practice and delivery leaders responsible for specialized service portfolios.
* Build a cohesive leadership team aligned around shared customer, operational, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen the organization’s delivery, operational, and customer-leadership capabilities.
* Create an environment that rewards collaboration, transparency, responsible decision-making, and enterprise-wide thinking.
* Challenge internal behaviors and legacy structures that prioritize practice interests over customer outcomes.
* Communicate a clear transformation vision and translate that vision into measurable operating priorities.
* Bring energy, resilience, and visible leadership to a large organization navigating substantial operational and market change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, client delivery, operations, managed services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large, complex delivery organization, preferably involving more than 1,000 employees or delivery professionals.
* Significant experience overseeing an annual business portfolio, delivery organization, or P&L approaching or exceeding $1 billion.
* Experience operating across multiple technology domains, such as managed infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Proven understanding of staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services operating models.
* A successful record of leading service transformation, organizational integration, operating-model redesign, or enterprise delivery modernization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer escalations, distressed engagements, operational crises, and service-recovery programs.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with margin improvement, utilization, workforce planning, productivity, cost management, and P&L performance.
* Experience leading through a matrixed organization in which delivery, practices, account teams, sales, finance, and customer leadership have interconnected responsibilities.
* Ability to understand a broad technology services portfolio sufficiently to make sound operational decisions and lead specialized practice executives.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Willingness to challenge established practices, address performance issues, and make difficult decisions when customer or business outcomes are at risk.
* Demonstrated judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and leadership maturity.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be
  
  

* Customer-centered Consistently prioritizes customer outcomes over internal structures and organizational boundaries.
* Operationally rigorous Establishes clear standards, measures performance, and maintains consistent accountability.
* Transformational Challenges legacy approaches and converts a broad modernization vision into executable change.
* Crisis-tested Remains composed and decisive during major customer, service, and organizational challenges.
* Commercially grounded Understands how delivery quality, cost, customer confidence, and profitability affect one another.
* Enterprise-minded Leads across the entire delivery organization rather than advocating for a single practice or technology tower.
* Influential Aligns senior stakeholders and specialized leaders without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Energetic and resilient Brings visible momentum to a large organization operating through significant change.
* Self-aware Understands their impact on others, listens to competing perspectives, and adjusts appropriately without compromising accountability.
* Decisive Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Location and Travel
  
  
This position may be based anywhere in the United States, with the Irving, Texas area preferred. The role is expected to require occasional travel of up to approximately 25 percent

Title: Information Security Manager – Cybersecurity Operations & Security Architecture
Description:
The Senior Information Security Manager is responsible for leading and managing the organization's (including Joint Ventures and Subsidiaries) cybersecurity operations, security engineering, offensive security, security architecture and emerging cybersecurity capabilities.The role ensures the effective protection of enterprise IT infrastructure, applications, networks, endpoints and critical business systems through a combination of proactive threat detection, incident response, security testing, continuous control validation and secure architecture.The position will lead the Security Operations Center (SOC), Red Team, Purple Team activities and Security Architecture capabilities, ensuring close collaboration between offensive and defensive security functions to continuously improve the organization's cybersecurity posture.This role will drive the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled cybersecurity capabilities, strengthen the organization's security posture against emerging AI-related threats, and ensure the secure adoption of AI technologies across the enterprise.Additionally, the position contributes to cybersecurity strategy, technology roadmaps, risk management, regulatory compliance, budget planning and the development of internal security capabilities.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Security Operations Center (SOC) & Cyber Defence**

* Manage and oversee day-to-day Security Operations Center activities, including internal teams and outsourced SOC/MSSP services.
* Ensure effective monitoring, detection, investigation and response to cybersecurity threats across enterprise IT environments.
* Oversee the implementation, operation and continuous improvement of SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, IDS/IPS and other security monitoring technologies.
* Develop and improve security monitoring use cases, detection rules, correlation rules and incident response play books.
* Lead threat hunting, threat intelligence integration, incident investigation and security event analysis.
* Manage cybersecurity incident response processes, ensuring timely identification, containment, eradication and recovery.
* Evaluate and leverage AI-driven security capabilities to improve threat detection, alert prioritisation, incident investigation and response automation.
* Oversee the adoption of AI-enabled security monitoring, behavioural analytics and threat intelligence capabilities.
* Explore machine learning and behavioural analytics to identify anomalous activities and emerging cyber threats.
* Establish and monitor SOC operational KPIs, including Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), alert quality and incident resolution.
* Coordinate major security incidents and ensure appropriate escalation and reporting to senior management.

**Red Team, Penetration Testing & Offensive Security**

* Lead and manage the organization's Red Team and offensive security activities.
* Establish an annual penetration testing and security assessment program covering infrastructure, networks, applications, cloud environments and critical systems.
* Oversee Red Team exercises, adversary simulations and authorized attack simulations to evaluate the organization's security resilience.
* Coordinate internal and external penetration testing activities and ensure appropriate coverage of critical technology assets.
* Review offensive security findings, assess associated business risks and prioritise remediation activities.
* Work closely with infrastructure, application, cloud and security teams to ensure identified vulnerabilities are addressed.
* Manage external security testing providers and ensure quality, scope and remediation follow-up.
* Evaluate emerging attack techniques, including those involving AI-enabled threats, to ensure offensive security assessments reflect evolving threat scenarios.

**Purple Team & Security Control Validation**

* Establish and manage Purple Team activities by facilitating collaboration between Red Team, SOC and security engineering teams.
* Conduct collaborative security exercises to assess the effectiveness of preventive, detective and response controls.
* Use the MITRE ATT&CK framework to map attack techniques, identify detection gaps and improve defensive capabilities.
* Validate SOC detection capabilities against simulated attack scenarios and relevant threat intelligence.
* Work with SOC and security engineering teams to improve detection rules, correlation logic, monitoring coverage and incident response procedures.
* Track identified security control weaknesses and ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated.
* Establish continuous security validation and improvement processes to measure the effectiveness of security controls.
* Evaluate opportunities to use AI-enabled analytics and automation to enhance security validation, detection engineering and threat analysis. Security Architecture & Engineering
* Develop, maintain and oversee enterprise security architecture principles, standards and technical security requirements.
* Lead security architecture reviews for new systems, infrastructure, applications, cloud services and technology projects.
* Ensure security-by-design principles are incorporated into technology implementations and system development lifecycles.
* Oversee security architecture and engineering capabilities covering network security, endpoint security, cloud security, application security, identity and access management, privileged access management and data protection.
* Promote Zero Trust principles, network segmentation, secure access controls, encryption and secure configuration standards.
* Review security solutions and technology designs to ensure alignment with enterprise security requirements and architecture standards.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture, IT infrastructure, cloud, application development and business teams to address security design gaps.
* Ensure security technologies are appropriately integrated into the organization's overall security architecture.
* Evaluate and establish security architecture requirements for AI platforms, AI-enabled applications, cloud-based AI services and associated infrastructure.

**Vulnerability & Exposure Management**

Title: Senior Network Developer - Topology Scaling

Execute network changes using existing procedures and tools, and develop new procedures as needed. Responsibilities include participating in solution and architecture design, developing standalone features, supporting operational rotations, providing break-fix support, serving as an escalation point, and leading post-event root cause analysis. Title: Security Operations Team Lead
Description:

The
**Security Operations Team Lead**

The role also leads the technical and operational delivery of the Group's phased transition from a traditional SOC to an AI enabled and, where justified, Agentic SOC under the strategy, investment approval and governance of the Information Security Manager. Each approved capability must show measurable security and productivity outcomes and a defensible return on investment (ROI), with secure operation and human accountability preserved.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Operations & Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach and manage two SOC analysts, overseeing daily priorities, technical development and high-severity investigations.
* Ensure effective 24/7 security monitoring, alert triage and escalation through the MSSP, maintaining oversight of incident queues, handovers and response SLAs.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident management across endpoints, networks, identity, email, cloud and critical business applications.

**Hands-on Cyber Defence & Incident Response**

* Perform hands-on security operations across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows/Linux, network and cloud security.
* Lead threat hunting, log analysis, detection engineering, alert investigation and security control validation using tools such as KQL and SPL.
* Act as the technical incident lead for major cybersecurity incidents, conducting digital forensics, evidence analysis, attack reconstruction, containment coordination and root-cause investigations.
* Develop and improve incident response playbooks, detection capabilities and defensive security controls.

**MSSP & Managed SOC Governance**

* Act as the primary operational liaison for the MSSP, overseeing service performance, monitoring effectiveness, escalation procedures and SLA compliance.
* Evaluate investigation quality, detection coverage and incident response, challenge findings where necessary and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Coordinate the MSSP with internal IT and security teams to continuously improve SOC operations.

**Threat Intelligence & Detection Engineering**

* Lead threat intelligence activities, including intelligence gathering, threat assessment, proactive threat hunting and identification of indicators of compromise.
* Improve SIEM monitoring through log-source management, detection rules, alert tuning, false-positive reduction and SOAR automation.

**AI-Enabled SOC Transformation**

* Lead the implementation of AI-assisted security operations and progressively introduce supervised agentic workflows to improve SOC efficiency.
* Develop and integrate AI-driven use cases for alert investigation, threat intelligence, event correlation, evidence collection and automated response workflows.
* Measure operational improvements, including analyst productivity, detection and response times, accuracy and cost savings, while ensuring appropriate security, governance and human oversight.

**Governance, Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain SOC procedures, incident registers, escalation matrices, management dashboards and security reporting.
* Report on cybersecurity incidents, emerging threats, MSSP performance, security control effectiveness and SOC improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Legal, HR, Privacy, Internal Audit and business stakeholders on incident response, investigations, audit requirements and cybersecurity resilience.
* Ensure all investigations, evidence collection, containment activities and business-impacting changes follow approved access, authorisation and governance procedures.

**Key Requirements**

  , including substantial recent hands-on DFIR and blue-team work, incident leadership, and management of enterprise SOC or MDR/MSSP services.

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare rigorous technical reports and concise executive-level assessments.

Title: Senior Manager - Incident Management
Description:
Lead incident and crisis management for the City Command Unit (CCU). Develop, maintain and assure the framework through which incidents across Qiddiya City are classified, escalated, commanded and resolved – from first report in the control room, through Bronze and Silver coordination, to Gold-level crisis activation – and act as the CCU’s senior incident lead during major incidents and crises. Ensure that incident response is consistent across assets, venues and partners, aligned with the Joint Security Operating Model and the Emergency Response Plan, accurately recorded, and followed by structured review, so that lessons are converted into better plans, procedures, training and decisions.

Responsabilities

* Lead the incident management function within the Crisis Operations sub-department of the City Command Unit, acting as the CCU’s subject-matter lead for incident and crisis management and providing professional direction on incident handling across the unit.
* Develop and maintain the incident management framework – incident classification and severity levels, the escalation matrix and thresholds, notification cascades and Gold–Silver–Bronze command roles – in line with the Joint Security Operating Model, the Emergency Response Plan and Incident Command System principles, for approval by the Director – Crisis Readiness.
* Act as the CCU’s senior incident lead at tactical (Silver) level during major incidents and crisis activations, as assigned under the command rota: establish command, set priorities, coordinate the response of Qiddiya’s operational functions and partners, and brief the Director – CCU and City Operations leadership.
* Assure live incident handling in the control room: support shift managers during significant incidents and ensure that the common operating picture, decision logs and situation reports are maintained and that escalation is timely and accurate.
* Manage the CCU’s crisis management arrangements – the crisis management room, support to the Gold-level crisis team, the crisis battle rhythm, information management and record keeping – so that the move from incident to crisis is controlled.
* Coordinate the multi-agency incident response interfaces with the Security Operations Centre, the contracted Fire and Rescue Service, medical response, Transport, the parks and venues and, through the CCU’s liaison arrangements, Civil Defence, Qiddiya Police and other public authorities, so that roles, primacy and handover are understood before and during incidents.
* Lead the post-incident process – hot debriefs, structured reviews, root-cause analysis and post-incident reports – and maintain the lessons and corrective-action register with named owners, target dates and closure evidence.
* Analyse incident data and trends, define incident-management performance indicators and report performance and emerging risks to the Director – Crisis Readiness and City Operations leadership, feeding the CCU risk register and readiness assessments.
* Build incident-command competence across the CCU and its partners: design and deliver training, coaching and assessment for shift managers, operators, duty managers and asset teams in incident command, decision-making, logging and briefing.
* Ensure incident response procedures, action cards and scenario playbooks are current and usable, working with the Senior Manager – Crisis Readiness and the Manager – Emergency Planning on their alignment with emergency plans and the exercise programme.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Crisis and Disaster Management, Risk Management, Security Management, Public Safety or a closely related discipline. (Master’s degree or doctorate in a relevant field is desirable.).
* Recognised emergency- or crisis-management certification (such as Certified Emergency Manager, or training to ISO 22320 incident management and ISO 22361 crisis management) is desirable.
* Incident-command qualification (Incident Command System or Gold–Silver–Bronze tactical command training) or business-continuity certification (ISO 22301 or CBCI) is desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in incident, emergency or crisis management, including at least 3 years in a senior role leading incident response or crisis management for a command centre, emergency service, major venue, critical infrastructure or city-scale operation.

* Experience in giga-project, theme-park, major-event, transport or government emergency-management environments is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience commanding or coordinating the response to major incidents at tactical (Silver) level or equivalent.
* Experience developing incident and crisis management frameworks, escalation arrangements and command structures, and embedding them across multiple operators and agencies.
* Experience supporting or advising a strategic (Gold) crisis management team during live crises and exercises.
* Experience leading post-incident reviews and converting lessons into tracked corrective actions.
* Experience working with civil-defence, police and emergency-medical authorities; Saudi Arabia or GCC experience is strongly preferred.

###

* Provide strategic oversight of global threat monitoring activities and intelligence outputs, ensuring alignment with global standards and best practices.

### 

### **Travel Security Risk Management**

  

* Oversee the delivery of travel security risk management services, ensuring alignment with client expectations and continuous intelligence assessments.

### **Crisis & Emergency Management**

* Experience in conducting profile specific security risk assessments.

* Ability to critically analyse multiple streams of security, logistics and threat-based information under time pressure and produce plans of action.
* Ability to identify key streams of effort and direct colleagues accordingly.
* On the ground experience in QatarEnergy’s Region of Operation.
* Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office Suite and other applications.

----------------------------

* Experience in successfully working cross culturally.

### 

### **Preferred Experience**

* Security consulting and training delivery experience.

Title: Digital Operations, Manager
Description:
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance. As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.

**The Opportunity:**

As a Digital Operations, Consulting Manager, you will lead small delivery teams and work directly with client stakeholders to translate complex operational, business, and technology questions into practical solutions leaders can trust and act on. The role emphasizes clarity, explainability, decision impact, and requires comfort working across operations, analytics, technology, and solution delivery. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

**Core Operations**

* Lead assessments of core operations across the operations, including production and plant operations, integrated planning and scheduling, field and site operations, maintenance and asset management, materials and inventory, and health, safety, and environment (HSE).
* Define operational performance frameworks and KPIs (e.g., throughput, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), asset availability, yield, unit cost, schedule adherence, safety performance) and use them to prioritize improvement opportunities and track value delivered.
* Shape operations strategies and improvement roadmaps, such as integrated and remote operations, production optimization, asset performance management, and workforce and field productivity.
* Design future-state operating models, processes, and workflows that connect field, plant, and control room operations with enterprise systems and decision-making.
* Act as the bridge between operations leaders (e.g., site, plant, field, and maintenance) and technology teams, making sure solutions reflect frontline realities and safety, regulatory, environmental, and operational risk requirements

**Decision Framing**

* Structure complex operational, business process, and technology challenges as decision problems under uncertainty.
* Lead assessments of how client operations and technology work today, and how mature they are, to identify and prioritize opportunities for digitization, automation, and emerging technology adoption, Lead assessments of how client operations and technology work today, and how mature they are, to identify and prioritize opportunities for digitization, automation, and emerging technology adoption.

**Applied Modelling**

* Apply quantitative techniques including: operational process and performance analysis; asset reliability, availability, and maintenance strategy analysis; capacity, throughput, and flow analysis; scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation; and assessment of technology options and their operational impact.

* Lead and coach small teams, oversee work quality, and resolve delivery issues.
* Engage directly with client stakeholders to align insights and solution design to decision needs and communicate results clearly.
* Work effectively across both business and technical stakeholder groups.

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

* Degree in industrial/systems engineering, computer science, business analytics, or a closely related quantitative field.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant field
* Must have prior consulting experience in related field
* Experience applying quantitative analysis and/or digital solutioning approaches to core operations (e.g., operations and maintenance, asset management), supply chain, or complex planning problems in defense, utilities, energy, mining, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries.

* Demonstrated ability to bridge operational context and analytics.
* Prior experience managing small teams and contributing to client‑facing engagements.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, cloud, AI, automation and digital workflow enablement is an asset.

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**The Role:**
The Manager, Migrations will lead our regional migration function as we transition customers from on‑premise deployments to our SaaS cloud platform. This role owns the end‑to‑end migration delivery for assigned customers, ensuring timelines are met, contractual obligations are honored, and customer expectations are managed throughout the Transition Use Period (TUP).
  
  
You will manage a team of migration engineers, coordinate closely with Sales, CON (Consulting/Implementation) teams, CLS (Customer Lifecycle/Success), and other cross‑functional stakeholders. Your focus is to deliver predictable, high‑quality migrations, avoid TUP extensions, and support pre‑sales POCs and infrastructure deployments that align with customer contracts.
  
  
**Location Requirement:**
This role requires full-time onsite presence at our corporate headquarters in Tysons Corner, VA, five days per week (Monday–Friday).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Migration Delivery & Ownership**

* Own the end‑to‑end planning, execution, and completion of customer migrations in the Americas region.
* Ensure migrations are completed within the agreed Transition Use Period; proactively identify and mitigate risks that could drive schedule extensions.
* Establish and maintain migration plans, milestones, and success criteria for each customer.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and customers to align migration scope, timelines, and responsibilities.

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Lead and manage a team of migration engineers, providing direction, prioritization, and coaching.
* Allocate resources across concurrent migration projects and POCs to ensure optimal coverage and delivery.
* Build and enforce best practices, standards, and repeatable processes for migrations and POC deployments.

**Customer Escalations & Requests**

* Act as primary point of escalation for migration‑related issues for the Americas region.
* Ensure customer requests, concerns, and escalations are addressed promptly and effectively.
* Communicate clearly and transparently with customers on status, risks, and mitigation plans.

**Cross**
‑
**Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with CON/Implementation teams to align migration activities with broader deployment and onboarding plans.
* Collaborate closely with Sales and Pre‑Sales to support Proof of Concept (POC) requirements, including environment setup, data migration, and technical validation.
* Work with CLS/Customer Success to ensure the deployed infrastructure, configuration, and service levels match contractual obligations and support long‑term adoption.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams on technical dependencies, platform capabilities, and improvement opportunities.

**Governance, Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure migration and POC environments are deployed in accordance with contractual terms, SLAs, security and compliance requirements.
* Track and report on key metrics (e.g., on‑time migration completion, TUP extensions, customer satisfaction, defect rates).
* Drive continuous improvement across migration processes, tooling, documentation, and templates.
* Contribute to playbooks and knowledge bases that improve consistency and reduce delivery risk.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in managing technical delivery teams in a SaaS, cloud, or enterprise software environment.
* Proven experience leading complex customer migrations or implementations (on‑prem to cloud strongly preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders in a fast‑paced environment.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (e.g., virtualization, networking, storage, security, scalability).
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to interact confidently with customers and executives.
* Experience handling escalations and driving issue resolution under time pressure.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration, experience in production environments. Kubernetes certifications such as CKAD or CKA are a strong plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global SaaS company undergoing large‑scale on‑prem to cloud transitions.
* Familiarity with common cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise integration patterns.
* Background working closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services organizations.
* Project management certifications (PMP, Prince2, or Agile/Scrum) are a plus.
* Experience defining and tracking KPIs for service delivery and customer success.

**Key Competencies**

* Ownership and accountability for outcomes
* Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills
* Structured problem‑solving and risk management
* Customer‑centric mindset with a focus on quality and predictability
* Ability to lead and motivate technical teams

Title: IT Infrastructure Manager - Network, Server & Azure
Description:
We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Manager to lead the design, operation, security, and continual improvement of Daniels Health’s core technology infrastructure. This role owns the enterprise network, server and hybrid infrastructure environment, and Microsoft Azure tenant, ensuring these platforms are reliable, secure, scalable, well-governed, and aligned with business requirements across global entities.
  
  
The IT Operations Manager is accountable for the operational health and strategic evolution of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. This includes network connectivity, firewalls, wireless, servers, virtualization, storage, backup and disaster recovery, Microsoft Azure services, identity and access integrations, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure lifecycle management. The role partners closely with Cybersecurity, Service Desk, Applications/Development, and business stakeholders to provide secure, resilient technology services for field, operations, and office personnel, both remote and onsite.
  
  
This position combines people leadership, hands-on technical depth, vendor management, operational governance, and project delivery. The successful candidate will establish clear ownership, standards, documentation, performance measures, and roadmaps for the infrastructure estate.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the operational performance, availability, capacity, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise network, server, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure.
* Lead and develop infrastructure personnel, contractors, and managed service providers; establish clear priorities, expectations, accountability, technical standards, and development plans.
* Design, implement, maintain, and continually improve resilient network services, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, internet connectivity, firewalls, wireless, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network segmentation.
* Own server and compute platforms, including Windows and Linux servers, virtualization, storage, file and print services, directory services, and supporting infrastructure components.
* Own the Microsoft Azure tenant and associated platform services, including subscriptions, resource organization, governance, networking, compute, storage, backup, monitoring, cost management, and role-based access controls.
* Manage hybrid connectivity and integrations among Azure, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, SaaS platforms, and business applications.
* Establish and maintain infrastructure monitoring, alerting, health checks, performance baselines, capacity planning, and operational reporting.
* Ensure infrastructure changes are properly planned, reviewed, tested, documented, communicated, and implemented in accordance with change-management and security requirements.

Security, Resilience, and Compliance
  
  

* Partner with the Cybersecurity team to implement and operate secure infrastructure configurations, identity controls, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, logging, endpoint/server hardening, and privileged-access practices.
* Ensure timely patching and remediation for servers, network devices, Azure services, and supporting infrastructure, using risk-based prioritization and documented exceptions where necessary.
* Own backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery capabilities for infrastructure services; conduct and document regular restoration and failover tests.
* Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster-recovery procedures for critical infrastructure platforms.
* Maintain accurate network diagrams, infrastructure inventories, configuration standards, runbooks, recovery procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensure infrastructure practices support applicable company security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements.

Architecture, Projects, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain a multi-year infrastructure roadmap covering network modernization, server and virtualization lifecycle, Azure adoption, security enhancements, resilience, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead infrastructure projects from requirements through design, implementation, transition to operations, and post-implementation review.
* Evaluate infrastructure technologies, service providers, licensing models, and architecture options; recommend solutions based on business value, reliability, security, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
* Manage infrastructure vendors, carriers, cloud providers, hardware suppliers, and managed service partners; hold vendors accountable to contractual obligations and service levels.
* Drive standardization, automation, and operational maturity through infrastructure-as-code where appropriate, scripting, repeatable deployment practices, and streamlined support processes.
* Establish and report meaningful operational KPIs, including platform availability, incident trends, patch compliance, backup success, recovery testing, capacity, project delivery, service performance, and Azure spend.
* Collaborate with the Service Desk to ensure effective escalation paths, knowledge transfer, service transition, and timely resolution of infrastructure-related incidents.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, including network, server, cloud, or hybrid environments.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in an infrastructure, systems, network, cloud operations, or IT operations management capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, vendors, managed service providers, or complex infrastructure projects.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network services across multiple sites and remote users.
* Experience administering and governing Microsoft Azure environments in a production enterprise setting.
* Experience with server administration, virtualization, storage, backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, patch management, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.
* Experience effectively communicating cross-functionally and with stakeholders at varying levels of the organization.

Technical Proficiencies
  
  

* Proven experience as an IT Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, or Operations Manager, with the ability to lead, mentor, and hold technical personnel accountable.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, wireless, WAN/SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, network segmentation, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including tenant/subscription governance, resource groups, virtual networks, network security controls, Azure Virtual Machines, storage, backup, monitoring, policy, cost management, and role-based access control.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory and Entra ID integrations, Group Policy, virtualization platforms, storage, backup and recovery, and core infrastructure services.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, and hybrid cloud architecture.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring and management tools, log management, vulnerability-management processes, and reporting platforms such as Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
* Experience with IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service-transition management. Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Experience managing infrastructure vendors, telecommunications providers, cloud service providers, licensing, contracts, and renewals.
* Ability to translate business requirements into secure, supportable, and cost-effective infrastructure solutions.

Professional Competencies
  
  

* Ability to see the broader contribution of infrastructure services to business continuity, productivity, customer service, cybersecurity, and growth.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritization, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and lead coordinated responses to major incidents.
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, options, and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Dynamic and innovative approach to problem solving, operational improvement, and technology modernization.
* Diligent in following and improving security, compliance, documentation, and change-control processes.
* Commitment to high-quality service, operational excellence, ownership, and continual improvement.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or comparable Azure certification.
* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or comparable network certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Security, cloud, virtualization, or disaster-recovery certifications relevant to the environment.

Title: DIRECTOR, INFORMATION SECURITY OPERATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

The Director, Information Security Operations is a key enterprise leader accountable for shaping and advancing GreenShield’s security strategy to safeguard digital and cyber assets in alignment with organizational objectives and risk appetite. This role continuously drives security resilience at scale, overseeing a 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC) and leading mission-critical functions including incident response, vulnerability and threat management, penetration testing, and cloud/application security. As a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will define and execute the security operations roadmap, influence enterprise architecture decisions, and ensure compliance with regulatory and customer contractual requirements. You will champion operational excellence, optimize capacity and demand, and embed a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Beyond operations, you will engage cross-functionally, contribute to board-level reporting and strategic planning to position Information Security as a business enabler and trusted advisor to the business.

Responsibilities:

* Provide strategic leadership, oversight, and operations of security technologies, controls, and platforms to protect enterprise assets and data.
* Lead cyber incident response activities, including containment, recovery, and management of incidents throughout their lifecycle, covering both internal and third-party risks.
* Ensure regular vulnerability scans, penetration testing and red team exercises, and build/manage a threat intelligence program to proactively identify and respond to emerging threats. Champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) practices, monitor remediation activities for go-live readiness.
* Collaborate with CISO and peers to set strategic directions and roadmaps in alignment with business strategy and risk appetite
* Present security posture, threat landscape and metrics to senior audiences
* Own security operations budget and vendor strategy ensuring cost optimization and technology alignment with enterprise
* Ensure control operating effectiveness to support regulatory and compliance requirements (SOC2, ISO27001, NIST-CSF)
* Influence enterprise security architecture roadmap
* Responsible for multi-cloud security, and advanced threat detections capabilities for applications
* Train, develop, and coach staff; promote cross-training and knowledge sharing; drive best practices and continuous improvement of delivery processes and user experience.
* Build high-performing team with succession planning for senior roles.
* Subject matter expert consultation, initiative coordination, audit and compliance, board and committee reporting contribution and strategic support

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

  

* University degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Minimum of 10 years of related experience in enterprise IT environments, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong technical knowledge in network and endpoint security
* Knowledge in application security and hardening
* Expert knowledge in cyber incident response technologies and understanding of adversarial techniques, tactics, and procedures (TTPs).
* Proficient in security event monitoring, threat intelligence, security operations center (SOC), and incident response technologies
* Strong leadership capabilities to motivate, build, develop and lead effective teams to achieve results.
* Verbal and written communication with a spectrum of senior management, executives, users, other technical teams, external customers, to enable and influence business outcomes.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and ability to work effectively under pressure.
* An accomplished facilitator with excellent interpersonal and communications skills that support working effectively in multi-disciplinary and multiple location team environments.
* Experience in partnering with technology, product and program management teams.
* Highly developed planning, organizing and negotiating skills; can manage multiple tasks, meet tight deadlines and respond to changing priorities.

NICE TO HAVE:

* University degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science or equivalent.
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSKv4)

**WHAT WE OFFER**

**Base Salary:** Range exempt

**Offer positioning:** Determined using relevant experience, skills, internal equity and current market data.

**Additional compensation:** Eligible for a discretionary target bonus.  
**Total rewards:** Health and dental coverage, retirement savings, paid time off and well-being support (up to $10,000 per year for mental health).  
**Posting disclosures:** This is for an existing vacancy.

We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.  
  
Where your growth means our growth.  
Where your voice is heard and valued.  
Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.  
  
We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.  
  
Here’s to Better Health for All!

Title: Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) for Security Operations
Description:
**Description**
---------------

**Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) for Security Operations (EMS 3)**

  

**WaTech: Leading the way forward!**

Washington Technology Solutions (WaTech) is at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge technologies that revolutionize how state services are delivered in Washington. By joining the WaTech team, you contribute to assisting other state agencies in providing essential services to millions of Washingtonians daily. WaTech manages the state's essential technology infrastructure, enhancing governmental efficiency, security and safety.

**About the position**

The Deputy Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at Washington’s Office of Cybersecurity (OCS) is a senior leadership role managing the Security Operations Center (SOC), Computer Incident Response (CIRT), and vulnerability management teams to track, coordinate, analyze and address security issues effectively. This position reports directly to the State Chief Information Security Officer and plays a critical role in the statewide organization of information security and is responsible for safeguarding the state’s information systems and data from security threats and exposures. In this role you will be relied upon to manage enterprise security platforms and facilitate services, advise WaTech, state agencies and the statewide enterprise on our security direction and resource investments, and administer a model to effectively manage information security incidents and risks.

**Duties**
----------

**Some of what to expect with this role:**

* Direct and oversee the operations of the Security Operations Center (SOC) and vulnerability management teams to actively defend the state government network from cyberattacks.
* Select and implement appropriate security tools for the hybrid (on-premises and cloud) infrastructure.
* Strategically design the collection and aggregation of data to detect and respond to threats, decrease false positives, and improve focus on real and actionable incidents.
* Measure SOC performance metrics and report on security operations and incident management to WaTech and state agency leaders.
* Oversee the management and maintenance of security platforms, tools and technologies, such as intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), security information and event management (SIEM) systems, network monitoring, and endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions.
* Coordinate with other IT and business units to integrate security controls and practices into the organization's operations.
* Direct and oversee the day-to-day operations of the Computer Incident Response (CIRT) team.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive security operations strategy aligned with the state’s overall security objectives and risk management framework.
* Monitor and analyze threat intelligence sources to identify threats and vulnerabilities to the organization's information assets.
* Establish and maintain a robust vulnerability management program in coordination with state agencies to identify, prioritize, address and report the vulnerability status in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

* 12 years of experience in the field of information technology\*. This experience includes:

  + Six years of recent experience in Information Security in each of the following areas:
    - Supervisory experience leading technical teams.
    - Developing and implementing policies and standards in a large enterprise environment.
    - Assessing security threats and recommending appropriate mitigation strategies and compensating controls.
    - Identifying security solutions that meet predefined regulatory/compliance requirements.

* *A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, Information Security, or a related field may substitute for four or six years, respectively**, of the overall 12 years of required experience.*

* Four years of experience in managing security operations, incident response, and threat intelligence functions.

* Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing security technologies and tools, including SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and endpoint protection systems.
* Strong understanding of relevant laws, regulations, and compliance requirements and experience interpreting laws, regulations, and administrative rules to understand how existing and newly introduced legislation impacts the delivery and implementation of information technology security policy and standards.
* Proven experience in a senior cybersecurity leadership role.
* Demonstrated ability to assess security threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies quickly.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and manage complex work tasks of security and technical employees in a fast-paced operational work unit.
* Ability to lead response efforts for single- or multiple-entity cybersecurity incidents.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues with technical staff, customer security professionals and non-technical senior management.
* In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity principles, technologies and best practices.
* Demonstrated knowledge and ability in negotiating and managing third-party vendor contracts.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills.
* The ability to take action to learn and grow.
* The ability to take action to meet the needs of others.

**Preference may be granted to applicants with the following:**

* A master’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, Information Security, or a related field.
* Applicable industry-accepted certifications, including but not limited to:
  + Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  + Holistic Information Security Practitioner (HISP) - Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).
  + Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA).
  + Certified in Risk and Information Systems Controls (CRISC).
* Department of Homeland Security (DHS) secret-level clearance.
* Ability to speak effectively and persuasively before a large audience.
* Demonstrated experience in budget development, implementation, and financial forecasting of information technology services.
* Demonstrated experience in project management, including managing multiple projects with strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development, such as participation in professional organizations (e.g., ISACA, ISC2) and attendance at industry conferences.
* Previous experience in managing information technology in the government or public sector is highly desirable.

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

**Telework:** This position is approved for telework. However, this position has to be onsite in our Olympia, Washington office weekly and must reside within a reasonable commuting distance to the office.

  
  

**We value diversity and different perspectives:**

WaTech is committed to providing equal access and opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees. We seek to attract and retain a diverse staff and welcome your experiences, perspectives and unique identity.*We invite you to include your preferred name and pronouns in your material to ensure we address you correctly throughout the application process.*

  

**What WaTech offers:**
